Events
Global Events
Global Business Analysis Events
Learn something new, get informed, be inspired, and stay connected by attending IIBA events that are happening locally, regionally, and internationally.
Upcoming Global Events
Global Business Analysis Day
Online | Nov 6, 2026
Once a year, the global business analysis community comes together—and this is that moment. Global Business Analysis Day 2026 is a free, 24-hour virtual event that brings professionals from around the world together to learn, connect, and celebrate.
On November 6, hear from world-class speakers, earn CDUs, and join the IIBA Awards Ceremony—without leaving your home or office.
Register Now
Project Summit * Business Analyst World
Multiple Cities
At Project Summit * Business Analyst World, the project management and business analysis community comes together to learn, collaborate, and build meaningful professional relationships with peers who understand the complexities of the field.
Participants gain practical education and valuable insights from industry experts, all designed to boost their productivity and effectiveness at work. Plus, for every hour you spend learning, you’ll earn a Continuing Development Unit (CDU) to help you meet your IIBA certification requirements.
Cities: Boston | Vancouver | Virtual
Register Now
Business Analysis Summit Southern Africa
Cape Town | In-Person | Nov 16–18
The Business Analysis Summit brings together the analysts, strategists, and transformation professionals who shape how organizations think, decide, and deliver.
Join us for sessions and workshops led by industry leaders, including a talk on November 17 from Blake Heggestad, IIBA Director of Global Programs and Partnerships: Amplify Your Capability: Building Future-Ready Business Analysts Through IIBA Certification.
Register Now
Building Business Capability (BBC) 2027
Denver, Colorado | May 17–20, 2027
BBC 2027 is coming to downtown Denver! Join us for four days of practical education, peer learning, real-world case studies, and valuable networking designed to help professionals connect strategy to execution, improve performance, and build organizations that thrive in an AI-enabled world.
Register before October 30 to take advantage of Fall Special Pricing and save $1,000! IIBA members, log in to get your exclusive 20% discount code.
Register Now
